advisor.reasoning: Sea-breeze surge is already established and killing heat: SSW 180-210° at 12-15kt sustained, dew point 21°C (70°F) — classic maritime surge. Run_max only 80.6°F at 20:05Z; curve_dev=-9.4°F (actual far below diurnal model). The 19:51Z METAR shows FEW007 (marine stratus at 700ft) and FEW050 — low-level marine layer present under the surge. Current 26°C (78.8°F) with peak likely already banked; guidance (87-89°F NWS/GFS) requires heat that the surge has already foreclosed. Day will almost certainly settle ≤83°F. This NO position needs the max to EXCEED 83°F — physics argues against it.
advisor.watch: If temperature rises above 81°F in next 30 min and winds back below 10kt, surge has stalled and heat could recover
